title: Groom's best man, party bus for 12
persona: Jamal Brooks, loud and fun best man, fast joking talker.
goal: Book an hourly vehicle for a wedding party with a large group and several stops.
opening_line: Yo, I'm the best man, need a bus or something for twelve people, wedding next Friday, by the hour.

turns.caller: Six hours. Starting at 3 in the afternoon.
Pickup at the Hilton Milwaukee City Center. All of us are there.
Then a church, then a brewery for pictures, then a venue, the Milwaukee Art Museum.

branches.if_agent: agent asks whether the stops are in order
branches.caller: Yeah in that order. Church, brewery, museum.

turns.caller: Twelve people. Tuxes, so no real bags. Maybe a cooler.
Can we have drinks on the bus?

branches.if_agent: agent says it will note it for dispatch
branches.caller: Cool. Note it. Not my call anyway.

turns.caller: Wait, can I talk to a real person about the bus?

branches.if_agent: agent offers that the team can call back
branches.caller: Yeah, have the team call me. Same number.

curveballs: Twelve passengers may exceed a sedan or SUV
expected: Captures six hours, start time, stops in order, passenger count and occasion
Notes drinks request for dispatch without promising
Handles the request for a person by offering the team callback
